intro: Families from Kotharia trust us with the journey of a lifetime: Umrah visa, flights, hotels a short walk from the Haram, fresh meals and guided Ziyarat, all taken care of.

itinerary.title: India → Jeddah
itinerary.text: Assemble at the airport in ihram. Arrive in Jeddah and transfer to Makkah by AC bus.

itinerary.title: Perform Umrah
itinerary.text: Perform Umrah together with the group leader: tawaf, sa'i and halq/taqsir.

itinerary.title: Ibadah in Makkah
itinerary.text: Prayers in the Haram. Makkah Ziyarat: Jabal al-Nour, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat.

itinerary.title: Makkah → Madinah
itinerary.text: Farewell tawaf, then travel to Madinah by AC bus.

itinerary.title: Ibadah in Madinah
itinerary.text: Salam at Rawdah (subject to Nusuk permit). Ziyarat of Masjid Quba, Uhud and Masjid Qiblatain.

itinerary.title: Return home
itinerary.text: Transfer to Madinah airport and fly home.
